key_insight: FK-ReMask steers a pretrained crystal diffusion model toward desired material properties by revising both crystal geometry and elemental composition without retraining.
engineering_relevance: For photovoltaic materials discovery, it enables joint targeting of three physical properties at inference time rather than requiring a newly trained model for each objective.
method: Maintain multiple denoising trajectories and replicate promising candidates using Feynman–Kac particle selection.
Re-mask committed atom types so candidates can explore alternative elemental compositions.
Apply gradient-free steering across continuous and discrete generation channels.
evidence_signal: Across four electronic, photovoltaic, and mechanical objectives, the abstract reports improved yield of stable, unique, novel and property-on-target materials, plus joint steering of three photovoltaic properties.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify gains or computational overhead, and generated candidates do not establish experimentally validated solar-cell performance.
paper_title: Multi-property Feynman-Kac Steering of Crystal Diffusion Models
